watch.summary: The streamer meticulously counts while rolling a fragile egg across narrow planks, only for it to suddenly shatter and send him screaming out of his chair.

beats.what: Streamer talks about being left alone on this difficult level.
Streamer begins carefully counting paces as he rolls the egg.
He continues counting rhythmically to guide the fragile egg.
The egg drops a small distance and shatters completely.
Streamer screams in outrage and jumps out of his chair.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The calm, rhythmic counting builds tension and a false sense of control right before the sudden failure. The explosive rage reaction and physical exit from the frame immediately capitalize on the sudden failure.
